title: Hydraulic-Scale Normalized and Geometry-Aware Face Representation Feasibility
purpose: Determine whether a materially new, globally bounded hydraulic-scale-normalized endpoint representation can regularize the catalog-wide material and geometry dependence that defeated the frozen absolute-head n49 endpoint-pair family, without retuning C7a thresholds, adding material-specific exception knots, or changing SWAP hydraulic physics.

already_tested_not_reopened_as_new: absolute-head anchored endpoint-pair interpolation from F-LMFP09 C3/C6/C7
global absolute-head density escalation from C4
simple linear effective-saturation plus positive-head bilinear direct-flux table from C5a
raw or transformed rectangular h_upper-gradient tables whose composition leaves the head envelope
h_lower=0 saturation-crossing knots on the h_upper-gradient ratio representation from B1/B2
source_bound_nonduplication.important_prior_positive_but_limited_evi: The F-LMFP09 saturation-aligned h_upper-gradient ratio family passed the four synthetic reference material/geometry classes but did not establish production-catalog generalization or response tangents.
source_bound_nonduplication.reason_for_new_workunit: C7a shows failures across ten Staring2018 materials, both geometries and multiple accuracy checks. A new representation hypothesis is required rather than another n49 repair.

constitutive_owner_separation.known_issue: Legacy standard-MvG near-saturation conductivity shortcut is value-discontinuous for part of the Staring2018 catalog.
constitutive_owner_separation.rule: F-LMFP10 must report overlap with this owner seam separately. It may not use a conductivity-based coordinate or alter the constitutive branch in A0. Numerical representation improvement does not prove the owner seam harmless, and owner-seam failures do not automatically falsify a representation away from that seam.

A0_characterization.name: MATERIAL_SCALE_COORDINATE_SCREEN
A0_characterization.reference: Independent conservative steady Darcy face BVP oracle from F-LMFP06/F-LMFP09
A0_characterization.baseline: Frozen F-LMFP09 n49 absolute-head endpoint-pair provider where evaluable
A0_characterization.candidate_output: log Darcian-to-MFP face-response ratio, with exact equal-head local-limit constraint and hydrostatic zero-flux identity preserved by construction

A_ALPHA_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.meaning: Normalize pressure head by the van Genuchten alpha scale only.
A_ALPHA_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.endpoint_axes: upper and lower endpoint heads use the same material-specific transformed coordinate
A_ALPHA_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.geometry: 10 and 20 cm remain explicit separate characterization classes in A0

B_H50_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.coordinate: x(h)=asinh(h/h50), with h50<0 defined by the standard van Genuchten retention relation at effective saturation Se=0.5 using the material alpha,n,m parameters
B_H50_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.meaning: Normalize by a material retention-transition suction that incorporates both alpha and n/m shape.
B_H50_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.endpoint_axes: upper and lower endpoint heads use the same material-specific transformed coordinate
B_H50_NORMALIZED_ENDPOINTS.geometry: 10 and 20 cm remain explicit separate characterization classes in A0

explicitly_not_in_A0: conductivity-coordinate because of the unresolved near-saturation K owner seam

axis_rule.construction: Use 49 deterministic nodes split between transformed negative and positive domains in proportion to transformed span, including both envelope endpoints and x=0 exactly. No node placement may depend on flux errors or C7a failed rows.

panel.reason: All C7a-failing materials plus predeclared passing controls span contrasting retention/conductivity shapes while keeping the first characterization bounded.

probe_generation.classifier: Use the frozen C6b/C7a classifier only as a common reporting slice, not as a tunable admission rule in A0.

metrics: fraction better than frozen n49 on rows common to both candidates
error versus NPAR, alpha, h50 and known K-jump factor
table memory and runtime interpolation corner count
A0_characterization.selection_rule: A0 may only nominate a coordinate family for A1 if it materially reduces both the widespread rare-tail failure family and the O01/O05 20cm strong-gradient failure without introducing structural/sign failures. No C7a acceptance threshold is used as an A0 pass/fail threshold and no qualification claim is allowed.
A0_characterization.if_neither_candidate_is_coherent: Do not tune nodes. Close A0 negative and formulate a materially different representation hypothesis before further testing.

future_geometry_gate_if_A0_nominates.name: A1_GEOMETRY_AXIS_CHARACTERIZATION
future_geometry_gate_if_A0_nominates.concept: Only after A0 nomination, characterize whether one shared per-material table with explicit dimensionless geometry coordinate L/|h50| or alpha*L is preferable to separate per-geometry tables.

hard_rules.production_runtime_target: O(1) face lookup or another explicitly bounded local operation

architecture_invariant_review.transactional_state: UNCHANGED; A0 has no timestep state
architecture_invariant_review.MultiSWAP: Candidate tables must remain shared immutable data, not per-column allocations
